user.title: Connect to OliveTin
user.description: Enter the OliveTin API URL. Leave username empty and put an API key in the password field to use bearer authentication.

data_description.host: OliveTin API base URL, for example http://olivetin.local:1337/api
data_description.username: Local OliveTin username, or leave empty when using an API key
data_description.password: Local OliveTin password, or API key when username is empty

start_action.name: Start action
start_action.description: Start an OliveTin action and optionally wait for the log entry result.

binding_id.name: Binding ID
binding_id.description: OliveTin action binding ID to start.

wait.name: Wait for completion
wait.description: Wait for the action to finish and include log entry fields in the response.

config_entry_id.name: Config entry
config_entry_id.description: OliveTin config entry to use when more than one is configured.

justification.name: Justification
justification.description: Optional justification text when required by the OliveTin action.

arguments.name: Arguments
arguments.description: Action arguments as a mapping (name: value) or a list of {name, value} objects. Missing values use OliveTin defaults when known.

list_actions.name: List actions
list_actions.description: List OliveTin actions and their argument schemas.

config_entry_id.name: Config entry
config_entry_id.description: OliveTin config entry to use when more than one is configured.

refresh.name: Refresh
refresh.description: Fetch a fresh action catalog from OliveTin before returning.
